description: Room take lifecycle: begin, append, complete, complete idle, delete.

preconditions: Room recording Available with 3 takes: take 1 at 0 ms for 10,000 ms, take 2 at 10,000 ms for 5,000 ms, take 3 at 15,000 ms for 8,000 ms; file of 736,044 bytes (23,000 ms).
The actor is its current Secretary.
Transcript Completed: line A 1,000-4,000 ms (speaker S1); line B 11,000-14,000 ms (S2, only voice in take 2); line C 16,000-20,000 ms (S1).

preconditions: Transcript in status Processing.
